level: finite dependency-capability inventory; no machine upgrade, semantic execution or mathematical promotion

machine.selection: exact dependencies/adva-machine.lock.json revision; later machine commits and pull requests are out of scope

question: Does the exact pinned adva-machine tree expose a versioned executable receiving profile or command whose declared input/output relation can receive the frozen 4,464-byte opaque request after AcceptedCurrentFixture and perform the two native diagram admissions plus the one qualified source/occurrence/path endpoint check witnessed in PR #231?

objects.required_relation: AcceptedCurrentFixture -> two native diagram admissions -> exact qualified endpoint-pair check -> recorded continuation outcome
objects.arithmetic_domain: The literal 1/1 is serialized Rational data only. No additive-zero, multiplicative-unit, inverse, commutation or arithmetic-truth law is queried.

quantifiers: Every tracked regular file at the one pinned machine commit, its declared command surface, specification catalog and test/profile manifests; one exact request relation. No quantification over later commits, untracked files, other repositories or possible new implementations.

candidate_grammar.exact_profile: a versioned committed machine profile or command declares the frozen request or a lossless typed input sufficient for both diagram admissions and the qualified endpoint check, and declares a receiver outcome
candidate_grammar.partial_match: a specification, primitive importer, generic transport, raw evidence intake or command exists but lacks at least one required input, check or receiver outcome
candidate_grammar.absent_within_inventory: no exact profile is found after enumerating the complete pinned tracked tree and command/profile registries

evaluation.success: Retain the exact path, command/profile identifier, declared input/output relation and replay command; execute at most one already-declared non-mutating probe if its required inputs and budget are available.
evaluation.refusal: A named candidate is rejected when its declaration lacks any required admission, qualified endpoint check or receiver outcome; retain the missing obligation.
evaluation.unknown: If the complete pinned inventory contains no exact profile, report Unknown/NoPinnedReceivingProfile with the exhaustive finite scope and do not implement, upgrade or substitute another machine. Environment or resource failure also remains Unknown with its exact residual.

protected_obligations: Do not modify or vendor the pinned machine tree, its submodules, the request, prior consumer, dependency locks or retained evidence.
Do not treat the presence of import_diagram_json, a related specification or a later machine profile as the required executable receiving relation.
Do not run a general build, fetch machine submodules or create a new machine profile in this route.

budget.memory: Measure inventory process maximum RSS with /usr/bin/time; no file size is interpreted as peak memory.

word_policy.reason: Existing profile, partial match, receive, Refused and Unknown vocabulary is sufficient. An inventory outcome is not a learned word.

residuals: Text and registry inventory can establish absence only in the pinned committed surface, not impossibility of an implementation.
